intelligence.human_view: v13 fixed the dead numbers, but he looked at the card and saw two things still wrong: the greeting reads as a label, and the notifications still read as buttons with numbers in them. The wisdom at the top, he said, looks better — that part is working. But a good morning has to feel like a good morning. The Hub's does: big bold white letters, a serif quote above, a gold line under it, the date in green and the time in gold, a deep board with soft light from the top. He took the picture himself so the feeling could be matched exactly — warmth is not a word, it is a picture. And the numbers: not pills, not buttons — big blocks, the name above and the big Dashboard number below, personal, work, world, with a plus the same size as the rest so a fourth can join whenever he wants. Three or four, whatever he wants — the count is dynamic. And then the charge that outlives the day view: think like a master interface artist. The page is a canvas. A work of art that is functional, usable, beautiful, useful. That is the standard every page is judged by now — not "does it work" but "is it a work of art that works." The v14 coordinator was dispatched 16:20Z on `the-ultimate-calendar` (from v13), the amendment carrying the Hub picture warmth + the Hz diamond went in 16:23Z; builder result and verification still owed at filing, the eye is his look at the card.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine your day page says good morning to you like a big warm hug — huge friendly letters at the top, right next to your picture! And the numbers are big beautiful blocks, like building blocks, with the name on top and a giant number underneath — personal, work, world — and a plus block the same size so you can add more whenever you want! The whole page is a work of art, like a painting you can use!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — imagine your day page greets you in the morning like a warm hug, dear, with big friendly letters right at the top beside your picture! And the numbers are big beautiful blocks, love, with the name on top and a great big number underneath — personal, work, world — and a plus block just the same size so you can add another whenever you like, dear. The whole page is a work of art, love — beautiful and useful at once!
intelligence.naya_view: THE GREETING AND THE TIME LIVE IN THE TOP BAR WITH THE DATE. HIS INITIAL — OR HIS PICTURE — AS A REAL OBJECT BESIDE THEM. THE GREETING CARRIES THE HUB'S WARM, INVITING GOOD-MORNING FEELING — THE HUB'S OWN GREETING IS THE REFERENCE, MATCHED EXACTLY. THE NOTIFICATION PILLS BECOME BIG BLOCKS ACROSS THE TOP: THE WORLD'S NAME ABOVE, THE BIG DASHBOARD DIGIT-TILE NUMBER BELOW, ONE BLOCK PER WORLD; THE + BLOCK IS THE SAME SIZE AND ADDS ANOTHER SOURCE, SO THE COUNT OF BLOCKS IS DYNAMIC. THE CITY NAME READS IN PROPER CASE. A PAGE IS A CANVAS — FUNCTIONAL, USABLE, BEAUTIFUL, USEFUL ART, NOT BUTTONS WITH NUMBERS IN THEM. THINK LIKE A MASTER INTERFACE ARTIST.
